    # Each 3x3 patch encodes one cell; retain its non-background marker (not 0 or 5).
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for r in range(0, h, 3):
        row = []
        for c in range(0, w, 3):
            vals = [grid[i][j] for i in range(r, min(r+3, h)) for j in range(c, min(c+3, w)) if grid[i][j] not in (0, 5)]
            row.append(vals[0] if vals else 0)
        out.append(row)
    return out
